name: July
summary:
July is a science-fiction mystery adventure game set in Japan in July 1999, amid widespread fears of an impending apocalypse inspired by Nostradamus' prophecies.

The story follows two protagonists: Makoto Takamura, a university student whose younger sister was killed in a terrorist bombing, and Joshua, a young man who survived mysterious human experiments. As they pursue their separate investigations, they become entangled in a conspiracy involving a powerful corporation, a religious cult, secret experiments, and individuals with extraordinary abilities.
